title: Chinese Municipality Establishing A Bank

page_data.en:
(C.I.D.) Office Notes

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. L. O. D...748...
Date..29..-11..-29..

November 25, 1929.

Sir,

It appears from enquiries made that Hsu Fu,
the Commissioner of Finance of the Chinese
Municipality is undertaking the organisation
of a Chinese Municipal Bank but there is little
hope of its being a success and it is doubtful
whether he can induce the public to subscribe to
the $3,000,000 Debenture Bonds to be raised
by the Municipality, owing to the war situation.
It is reported that although the Chinese merchants
of various classes have agreed to contribute
$1,200,000, not a cent has yet been received.
Until the financial situation shows signs of
improvement, nothing can be done towards the
securing of a house in Tientsin Road and
other preparations.

（批：IV Cf Information 28/11 Scans 100!）

Ian Kevliang
Clerical Assistant.

Officer i/c
S.B.    II

（批：Duffy NOV 28 1929）

The establishment of a
municipal Bank comes within
the scheme to lay out in Hongkew
district an administrative area,
although the original idea was
that the bank would be accommodated
in the building which it was proposed
should be erected in that area.
Activities in connexion with this
scheme are being watched by this
office.

HR    （批：III 29/11/29 A/D.C.I. Information）

（刑事调查处）办公室笔记

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查处档案室
编号 L. O. D...748...
日期..29..-11..-29..

1929年11月25日。

先生，

经查询获悉，华界财政局局长徐福（音译）正着手组建一家华界市立银行，但成功希望渺茫。鉴于战事局势，他能否促使公众认购华界拟发行的300万元信用债券，亦属可疑。据报，尽管各界华商已同意捐助120万元，但迄今分文未收。在财政状况出现好转迹象之前，无法开展在天津路 securing 房屋及其他准备工作。

（批注：IV 参见11月28日情报 扫描100！）

伊恩·凯夫良（Ian Kevliang，音译）
文书助理

主管警官
特别分部 II

（批注：达菲 1929年11月28日）

设立市立银行属于在虹口区规划行政区域方案的一部分，尽管最初的想法是将银行安置在该区域内拟建的建筑物中。本处正在监视与该方案相关的活动。

HR （批注：III 1929年11月29日 副刑事调查主任 情报）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D............
Date................
Morning translation.

November 23, 1929.

CHINESE MUNICIPALITY ESTABLISHING A BANK

The Min Kuo Pao and the other local newspapers
publish the following articles:-

The Shanghai (Chinese Territory) Municipality
is making preparations to establish a City Bank. It is
reported that the Bank will be inaugurated in January, next
Year, and that it will be located on Tientsin Road.

D.C.I's remarks
Enquiries
(Sd.) R.C.A.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查处档案室
编号 I. O. D............
日期................
晨间译文。

1929年11月23日。

华界设立银行

《民国日报》及其他本地报纸刊登了以下文章：

上海（华界）特别市政府正筹备设立一家城市银行。据报道，该银行将于明年一月开业，行址设在天津路。

副刑事调查主任备注
查询
（签名）R.C.A.
